title: Understanding Fold and All-In in Texas Hold'em Poker
summaryJa: テキサスホールデムポーカーで重要な「フォルド」と「オールイン」という2つのターム、その意味と実際の使用例を説明します。
segments: Texas Hold'em is a popular card game. Players try to win money by making the best hand.
To play the game well, you need to know the important words. Two key words are "fold" and "all-in.
" These words help you understand how players make choices at the table. "Fold" means to stop playing your hand.
When you fold, you give up your cards. You do not continue in that hand.
For example, you have two cards. They are not good cards.
Another player makes a big bet. You think you cannot win.
So you fold. You lose the money you already put in the pot.
But you do not lose any more money. Fold is a smart choice when your cards are bad.
"All-in" means you put all your money into the pot. You push all your chips forward.
You cannot bet more money. You have no chips left.
For example, you have twenty dollars in chips. You see very good cards.
You believe you will win the hand. So you say "all-in" and push all twenty dollars into the pot.
Now you wait to see the final cards. If you win, you get all the money.
If you lose, you lose everything. Learn these two words well.
Fold helps you save money when cards are bad. All-in helps you win big money when cards are good.
Good players use both choices at the right time. This is an important part of Texas Hold'em.
